title: Charles Starkweather — Survival, Reproduction, Illusion #Shorts
description:
The bleak reading of Charles Starkweather is also the most testable one. Charles Raymond Starkweather (November 24, 1938 – June 25, 1959) was an American spree killer who committed the fatal shootings of eleven people in Nebraska and Wyoming between the dates of December 1957 and January 1958, when he was nineteen years old. He killed ten of his victims between January 21 and January 29, 1958, the date of his arrest.

The story Charles Starkweather tells about itself is the last thing to be trusted. Starkweather was convicted after the jury deliberated for 22 hours for the murder of Jensen, the only murder for which he was tried. On May 23, 1958, he was sentenced to death, and Starkweather was executed in the electric chair at the Nebraska State Penitentiary in Lincoln, at 12:05 a.m. on June 25, 1959.
